# Unbound-statement regression

This public countermodel's descriptor omits the two verifier images from public
binding. An experimental low-level driver accepted its false DLEQ
statement. Both supported artifact entry points and the original-source Lean
reference must reject the descriptor before reading the candidate proof.

This is a negative fixture, not an additional supported protocol or a security
theorem. All bytes are public. The original common source still constructs,
testing that artifact admission imposes the additional public-validator contract.

`validator.json` carries the forgery's public values in the current input
shape; the reference refuses the descriptor before it reads them.
